body:
From MMR-35 (accepted): wiring `NavalContentFactory` into generation is yours, alongside the MMR-34 initializer.
1. Run `NavalContentFactory.ShipyardLevels(naval, ports)` before `SettlementFactory.Build(..., shipyardLevels)`, so the Settlements document carries the naval shipyard levels. Without it every port gets the economy policy's level 1, and the factory refuses.
2. After the startup initializer: `new NavalContentFactory(naval, Factions, SPCultures, ShipHulls, MissionShips, ShipSlots, partyTemplates).Build(campaign, travel, ports, cells, factions, world, startup)`. Its Factions document (the pirate clan aliases) and `DeclaredKeys` join the registration; the MMR-30 plan accepts them.
3. `Result.Plan.Landlocked` goes to `IGeneratedWorld.NavalPlan` before `InitializeGameStarter`, and into the package as `adapter.dataset.navalLandlocked`.
4. `NavalException.Codes`/`.Retryable` (`quality.naval_*`) are bounded rejections for MMR-44.
